hero.title: Everyone solves problems. I make sure we're solving the right ones.
hero.deck: I build the first version myself, then grow the team that takes it to production. Tenth employee at SOPHiA GENETICS, now 400+ people. From thermal engineering to VP, by way of software, data visualisation, photography and now AI.

ribbon.title: From engineer to VP, still hands-on
ribbon.caption: Each bar is a role, drawn to scale. Height marks seniority. The thin bands show photography, engineering and data visualisation that never stopped.

notes.title: 1995 · Thermal & simulation engineer
notes.text: 3D finite-element simulations, extending a FORTRAN solver with new physics.

notes.title: 2008 · Photography
notes.text: A sabbatical for visual studies, then exhibitions and awards. It shaped how I see data.

notes.title: 2013 · SOPHiA, tenth employee
notes.text: Joined as data visualisation engineer. Built the first platform UI myself.

notes.title: 2018 · First VP
notes.text: Functional & UX design, after growing the front-end team I started.

notes.title: 2019 · AI & deep learning
notes.text: A year invested in machine learning, before returning to SOPHiA to lead product.

notes.title: 2025 · VP, Design & Innovation
notes.text: A small team focused on product vision and strategic features.

principles.title: Clarify first
principles.text: Speed matters less than direction. I make sure the team is solving the right problem before anyone writes a line.

principles.title: Build it myself
principles.text: I prototype the first version hands-on, with AI as a daily tool. Deep enough to direct it, fast enough to ship before the spec is done.

principles.title: Scale through teams
principles.text: I grow the team that takes what works to production, and delegate with the credibility of having built it.

principles.title: Data into stories
principles.text: Complex datasets turned into clear interfaces people actually use. Advanced dataviz libraries have been my core tools since 2012.

close.title: Need someone who clarifies before building, and builds before delegating? Let's talk.

sections.label: Profile
paragraphs: Part scientist, part designer, part engineer, and a leader who makes the call. I'm most useful where those meet: products built on dense data, where mistakes are costly, from private banking to clinical genomics. When the data is incomplete, I still decide, explain why and own the outcome. I have led organisations of up to 25 people across development, product and design.

sections.label: Expertise
paragraphs: Product. I turn unclear needs into a roadmap a team can act on, from portfolio management platforms for private banks to a clinical genomics platform.
Design & data visualisation. I design for experts who live in their data: bankers, broadcasters, clinicians. From a world map of paediatric HIV cohorts to genomic viewers.
Engineering. I write the code that proves an idea before the team scales it: Java platforms for banks, tapeless TV production at RTS, the first React web app at SOPHiA GENETICS.
AI. From a 2004 datastore that took near-natural-language questions to a multimodal oncology prototype, backed by training in deep learning, medical diagnosis and NLP.

sections.label: Background
paragraphs: My roots are in science and physics: thermodynamics, fluid mechanics, heat transfer, and the fundamentals underneath them. I started out running finite-element simulations in FORTRAN. A second master in computer science moved me into software: telecom, private banking, broadcast. A year out for photography gave me the visual side. Data visualisation is where the three meet.
